dataset_candidates.author: cod
verified: Authenticated YOLOv11 archives for versions 1 and 2 inspected on 2026-09-12 without importing either version.
Project overview advertises helper_hut, but v1 data.yaml has 38 classes and v2 data.yaml has 23 classes; neither export contains helper_hut or bob_hut annotations.
For v1, 972 of 1028 original filename families overlap existing imports. The other 56 images have partial labels for existing building classes, not the missing target classes.
dataset_candidates.risk: The project overview class list is not the frozen version export. Importing it as new training or test data would duplicate prior examples and leave helper_hut unlearned.
dataset_candidates.next_step: Look for a version with actual helper_hut boxes or manually curate independent village captures; do not use either inspected export for this gap.

dataset_candidates.author: htrg
verified: Authenticated YOLOv11 archive downloaded and structurally audited on 2026-09-10.
The 1883 exported images reduce to 431 original .rf. families after augmentation grouping.
All 431 original family identifiers exactly match the existing kiet-walls-v6 source; there are zero new independent families.
The published version applies ten outputs per training example plus horizontal flips and 90-degree rotations.
dataset_candidates.risk: Adding this fork would duplicate the same underlying images, overweight easy examples and make validation gains misleading.
dataset_candidates.next_step: Keep excluded from train/validation/test; look for independent owner gameplay screenshots instead.

dataset_candidates.author: clashia
verified: Authenticated YOLOv11 archive downloaded and structurally audited on 2026-09-10.
Brightness/blur variants reduce to two isolated sprite renders for each wall level 1-19.
Wall levels 18 and 19 are present, but the source has no independent gameplay examples.
dataset_candidates.risk: Training and validating on two near-canonical renders per level would overfit and produce misleading level accuracy.
dataset_candidates.next_step: Use only to verify labels on future licensed gameplay crops for wall levels 1-19.

dataset_candidates.author: CoCAnalyzer
verified: Authenticated YOLOv11 archive downloaded and structurally audited on 2026-09-10.
The version contains 228 unaugmented gameplay screenshots, 1246 boxes and no exact overlap with the current ClashCompare dataset.
Annotations cover TH18, Monolith, Revenge Tower, both Multi-Gear Tower modes and all four Firespitter orientations.
Five distributed source images were visually inspected and confirmed to be real gameplay captures rather than canonical sprites.
dataset_candidates.risk: The source specializes in recent TH18 structures and does not label every older building visible in each village.
dataset_candidates.next_step: Import as training-only data, fine-tune from frozen V5 with teacher distillation and promote only if the unchanged reserved test improves.

dataset_candidates.author: Pedros Workspace
verified: Project class list inspected in browser and contains Little_Guardian.
Only one unique screenshot / three augmented boxes were reported in the source lineage.
Dataset mixes buildings, troops, spells, UI and misspelled classes.
dataset_candidates.risk: One unique Guardian example cannot make the class learnable; importing partial mixed labels would create false negatives.
dataset_candidates.next_step: Use only to help locate a manually reviewed seed example; collect multiple original owner screenshots of both Longshot and Smasher.

dataset_candidates.author: Pauls Workspace
verified: Project page and gallery inspected in browser.
Masks trace wall networks in complete village screenshots.
Download page requires Roboflow sign-in.
dataset_candidates.risk: Converting each network polygon to one YOLO bounding box would teach giant false boxes and would not count individual wall pieces.
dataset_candidates.next_step: Download after sign-in, preserve raw masks, then evaluate a separate segmentation/counting adapter or manually re-annotate individual wall pieces.

dataset_candidates.author: coc
verified: Project page inspected again on 2026-09-09.
The 202 explicit level classes include archer towers, cannons, mortars and many other home-village buildings.
Roboflow reports 126 source images but zero dataset versions and zero downloadable models.
dataset_candidates.risk: Raw gallery previews cannot replace a versioned export: annotations, split integrity and duplicate families cannot be audited reliably.
dataset_candidates.next_step: Revisit only if the author publishes a versioned export; otherwise collect owner screenshots and annotate them locally.

dataset_candidates.author: Christopher Pezza / chiefpansancolt
dataset_candidates.license: MIT for the repository; underlying game images also remain subject to the Supercell Fan Content Policy
verified: Repository license and README inspected on 2026-09-09.
All referenced PNG paths were checked locally; no referenced image is missing.
521 of the corrected catalog's 531 building-level pairs have at least one canonical reference (98.12%).
The audit detected duplicate level records in 13 source building files and 32 level/path inconsistencies.
Blacksmith levels 1/2, 3/4, 5/6 and 7/8 intentionally share the same source image and are therefore not visually separable from this source alone.

The remaining ten gaps are Builder's Hut 8, Monolith 5, Workshop 9, Blacksmith 10, Giant Bomb 12 and Town Hall Guardian levels 1-5; the five non-Guardian gaps now have separately verified Google-discovered references.
dataset_candidates.risk: Canonical transparent assets are not independent gameplay screenshots. Using them in validation/test would inflate metrics, and directly augmenting/redistributing modified assets is not authorized by the repository license alone.
dataset_candidates.next_step: Use only for label and visual review of real licensed gameplay crops; keep it outside train/validation/test until the upstream asset rights and domain-gap protocol are explicitly resolved.

dataset_candidates.author: GoblinsFarm and Clash Ninja; levels cross-checked against official Supercell release notes
dataset_candidates.license: No machine-learning training licence established; Supercell game art remains subject to the Supercell Fan Content Policy
verified: Results were discovered through Google Images/web search, then checked on their original pages rather than trusted from thumbnails.
Each downloaded file was opened and visually checked against its page label.
SHA-256 hashes, source pages, direct image URLs and official release-note confirmations are recorded in the local manifest.
Official Supercell notes confirm Builder's Hut 8 and Monolith 5 in Anime Fury, and Workshop 9, Blacksmith 10 and Giant Bomb 12 in Sound of Clash.
dataset_candidates.risk: These are isolated canonical renders, not diverse gameplay crops. Their public availability does not provide permission to train on them, and using them for validation would produce misleading metrics.
dataset_candidates.next_step: Use the images only to verify labels on independently licensed or owner-provided gameplay screenshots.

policy: Wiki and official images are visual references, not automatically training data.
Do not scrape preview overlays as replacement for source annotations.
Do not import a dataset without explicit license, class audit and duplicate audit.
Never infer hidden traps from expected counts or base geometry.
